title: ClusterHistoryPoint
description: Hop dong giua clustering va query-api / UI xu huong: moi chu ky THEM MOI mot ClusterHistoryPoint. Retention: worker xoa cac diem co recorded_at nho hon thoi gian UTC hien tai tru RETENTION_DAYS (mac dinh 30 ngay, toi thieu 1), kiem tra sau chu ky va toi da moi gio mot lan trong moi process; diem tai cutoff duoc giu. Diem qua han co the con den lan don tiep theo hoac lau hon khi worker dung/loi; du lieu qua han khong duoc dam bao. Replay --window-to khong chay retention. History duoc dung ca cho phat hien incident tai phat, nen viec xoa co the gioi han bang chung tai phat cu. Khong doi/dung lai cluster-record.schema.json.

cluster_id.description: Phai khop voi ClusterRecord.cluster_id tuong ung (xem cluster-record.schema.json)

score.description: Anomaly score tai chu ky nay - cung cong thuc voi ClusterRecord.score

status.description: Trang thai cum tai chu ky nay (xem cluster-record.schema.json muc status)

recorded_at.description: window_to cua chu ky clustering luc tinh diem nay - dung lam truc thoi gian khi ve bieu do

first_seen.description: Bat dau khoang log cua chu ky, luu noi bo de xu ly incident tai phat

last_seen.description: Log moi nhat trong chu ky, luu noi bo de phat hien tai phat sau Resolve
